name: Komatsuzaki Aya
source:
Aya is [url=/c82292]Kanata[/url], [url=/c72476]Touka[/url] and [url=/c72475]Kazane[/url]'s childhood friend. In their childhood, she and Kanata's family were neighbours and so she spent a lot of time playing with Kanata, for whom she began to develop different feelings but whose scope she did not yet understand.

When Kanata returns to the city, she is naturally excited and eager to see him again and reintroduce him to the daily life of the city, such as introducing him to his new classmates and their head teacher, who is none other than [url=/c72478]Sakura[/url], while sharing as much time as possible with him since they can now live under the same roof as him and repeating their little rituals they had in childhood like waking him up in the morning, taking a nap with him, watching horror movies with him and many other things.

However, she didn't expect her to have to fight with the other girls to be able to spend time with him, especially with [url=/c72477]Rina[/url] who monopolizes him to play video games...
